name: Finance - Monthly Report Generation

parameters.query: SELECT tenant_id, SUM(CASE WHEN type='INCOME' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as total_income, SUM(CASE WHEN type='EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as total_expense, COUNT(DISTINCT id) as transaction_count, date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') as report_month FROM fin_transactions WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month') AND created_at < date_trunc('month', NOW()) AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id;
INSERT INTO fin_monthly_reports (tenant_id, report_month, total_income, total_expense, net_profit, transaction_count, generated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$3-$4,$5,NOW());
SELECT channel_id FROM fin_report_config WHERE tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1;
